nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: Only changes are sent, so this interval sets how fast you hear, not how much you hear. Five minutes means a fault is never sitting unreported for a quarter of an hour.

nodes.name: Ask how things are
nodes.notes: Deliberately over the public URL rather than a shortcut to n8n: this way nginx, the certificate and basic auth are all on the path being tested.

nodes.name: Tell Darren
nodes.notes: bodyContentType must be set explicitly. The node's default is html but that default only applies when the field is present.
